after.selection: lowest threshold with precision >= 0.85 on calibration (hybrid: model OR simple rule)

model_only.selection: lowest threshold with precision >= 0.85 on calibration

model.selection: lowest threshold with precision >= 0.85 on calibration (hybrid: model OR simple rule)

warning.note: Thresholds chosen on calibration households; all numbers reported on clean test households. The simple rule is 'current spendable money covers fewer days than the next transfer is expected to take'.

stress.description: Three consecutive transfers (from transfer 6) arrive 21 days later each and 30% smaller.
stress.note: The forecaster was not trained on shocks. Protection comes from the rule that widens the range when a transfer is overdue, and from warnings that read the live balance.

irregular_experiment.description: Adds sender-regularity features (gap variation over the last 6 transfers, longest recent gap, gap trend) and calibrates the range separately for senders who look regular / semi-regular / irregular in their own history.
irregular_experiment.reason: Not adopted: irregular improves materially failed. The original forecaster is kept. It is switched on anyway by team decision (FORCE_IRREGULAR_MODEL); the table shows what it changes.

sequence_experiment.description: Tried a temporal variant of LightGBM (last 6 gaps, last 3 amounts, fast and slow moving averages) and a small neural network over the last 6 gaps and 3 amounts. Same test households, same metrics. A variant replaces the current model only if timing error is at least 0.15 days lower with amount error and coverage no worse.
sequence_experiment.reason: Neither temporal variant beat the current model, so LightGBM with the original features stays. Short, noisy transfer histories give sequence models little extra signal. The temporal features are switched on anyway by team decision (FORCE_TEMPORAL_FEATURES).

live_model.description: LightGBM quantile model with conformal calibration; sender-regularity features and group-wise calibration (enabled by team decision; the offline rule did not require it); lag and rolling features (enabled by team decision; the offline rule did not require it)

adaptive.reason: Not adopted: no meaningful gain (needs 0.05 days lower error with coverage no worse).
adaptive.description: Each household's recent forecast errors (how much later or earlier its transfers came than predicted) nudge its next forecast: an exponentially weighted correction, shrunk while history is short, capped at 10 days. Parameters chosen on calibration households.
